title: Joseph and His Brothers (Part 2): The Brothers' Plot

source.brief: Joseph and His Brothers (Part 2): the brothers see him coming, plot to kill him, Reuben intervenes, and they throw him into the pit

characters.JOSEPH: a beardless 17-year-old teenage boy with a smooth youthful face, short black curly hair, wearing a vibrant robe of many colours
characters.BROTHERS: older bearded brothers in plain brown shepherd robes
characters.JACOB: an old man with a long white beard and a dark blue robe
characters.JOSEPH_STRIPPED: a frightened beardless teenage boy with short black curly hair in a plain torn tunic
characters.REUBEN: a tall man in his thirties with a full dark brown beard and furrowed brow, wearing a plain brown shepherd robe with a dark red sash

scenes.narration: Joseph's brothers saw him coming from far off, and they plotted to kill him.
scenes.image_prompt: {BROTHERS} huddled together on a rocky hillside, glaring toward a tiny distant figure approaching across dry pastureland, low angle from behind the group, harsh afternoon sun casting long shadows

scenes.narration: Israel had sent Joseph from Hebron to check on his brothers and the flocks.
scenes.image_prompt: {JACOB} standing at the doorway of a tent in a green valley, one hand raised as he sends someone off on a journey, medium shot, soft morning light, sheep grazing in the background

scenes.narration: At Shechem, a man found him wandering in a field. Joseph asked for his brothers. They'd gone to Dothan, the man said.
scenes.image_prompt: {JOSEPH} wandering alone through a wide open field of tall dry grass, looking around searchingly, a lone stranger standing at the field's edge in the distance, wide shot, hazy midday light

scenes.narration: In Dothan, the brothers saw him and said, “Behold, this dreamer cometh.” Kill him, they said. Throw him in a pit. Say a wild beast ate him.
scenes.image_prompt: {BROTHERS} leaning close together in a tense whisper beside grazing sheep, faces hard and scheming, close-up group shot, dusty wilderness behind them, dramatic late afternoon side light

scenes.narration: Reuben heard. Don't kill him, he said. Shed no blood; just throw him in this pit. He meant to bring Joseph back to their father.
scenes.image_prompt: {REUBEN} standing with both hands raised in protest, pointing toward a dark stone-lined pit in the dusty wilderness, medium shot at eye level, warm golden evening light

scenes.narration: When Joseph arrived, they stripped off his coat of many colours and threw him in the pit. It was empty. There was no water in it.
scenes.image_prompt: {JOSEPH_STRIPPED} sitting alone at the bottom of a deep dry stone pit, looking up in fear toward a circle of bright sky far above, high angle looking down into the pit, shaft of light falling on dusty empty ground
